offer.text: I can't sleep with that moaning beyond the fence. You've a strong arm — would you walk the walls tonight and put down four of the dead for us?

accept.text: Bless you. I'll rest easier knowing you're out there.

decline.text: Then I'll lie awake and listen, I suppose.

in_progress.text: Still hear them out there. Four would set my mind at ease.

ready.text: It's gone quiet beyond the fence. Thank you, truly.

complete.text: A neighbor who stands the wall is a neighbor indeed. My thanks.
